Iran
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Teheran, Iran.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Sarajevo):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina do not need a visa for a tourist stay of up to fifteen (15) days in a period of 180 days on the territory of the Islamic Republic of Iran.
It is not possible to extend the visa-free stay of 15 days by staying on the territory of IR Iran.
Citizens of the Islamic Republic of Iran are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Holders of diplomatic and service passports of the Islamic Republic of Iran are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days.
Security conditions: Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina are not recommended to travel to the Islamic Republic of Iran. Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina who are in this country, in case of need, can contact the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Tehran, by telephone number: +989364032630 and +989104835866 and by e-mail address: bhembassyir@gmail.com, with the specified details of name and surname, address of residence in Bosnia and Herzegovina, number of travel document of Bosnia and Herzegovina and place of residence in the Islamic Republic of Iran, as well as with the necessary contact information, in order to found a way to provide support. It is also possible to contact the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina via phone number: +387 33 281 234 and e-mail: emergency@mvp.gov.ba. We recommend respecting Islamic customs in the way of dressing and behaving.
Sanitary conditions: Good with a lack of last-generation medicines in the provinces.
Currency: Use euros. No credit cards are allowed.
Drugs: The death penalty
Call number: ++98There is a roaming agreement for mobile phones, but only for certain models.
